name: Jasmine Directory

sources.title: Submission form — Standard $59/yr (recurring), Express $79 one-time, Ultimate $149 one-time

requirements: General business/website directory — pick the category first; the submission form renders inside a chosen category (Business & Finance shown)
Three paid tiers only: Standard $59/year recurring, Express $79 one-time, Ultimate $149 one-time
Standard tier is ANNUAL RECURRING billing; Express and Ultimate are one-time permanent listings
All tiers include an editor/specialist review of the submission
preparation: Website URL and business details (address, phone, fax fields on Standard+)
Choose category carefully — placement ranking depends on tier within that category
Up to 5 images for the photo album, company logo (Ultimate), social profile URLs (Ultimate)
Deep link URLs if taking Express (2) or Ultimate (5)
workflow: Browse to your category on jasminedirectory.com and open its submission form (Submit nav link)
Pick a tier: Standard ($59/yr, listed below Express/Ultimate), Express ($79 one-time, above Standard + homepage rotation), or Ultimate ($149 one-time, always top of category)
Complete the listing fields and pay
Editors conduct a review; the listing page goes live with the tier's link structure
watchFor: Standard tier auto-renews annually — the one-time-fee Express tier is only $20 more and permanent
'Verified business badge' is an UPGRADE on Standard but included on Express/Ultimate
Tier determines ordering: Ultimate always tops the category, Standard sinks below all paid-one-time listings
Deep links are capped by tier (Standard: none extra; Express: 2; Ultimate: 5)
Footnotes mention an 'Editor Review' post linking to your site — read the linked terms; continuing accepts Terms of Use
countsAsLive: Listing page exists under the chosen category on jasminedirectory.com with a direct link to your site, ordered per tier
unknowns: Whether any free submission option exists elsewhere on the site — none was found
